notes: Partition verified: all 13 source and 14 target IDs used exactly once.

s006 τήν takes the supplied *their* under rule 20's second arm: no genitive pronoun or other source word stands free to carry the possessive, so the article is what it realizes, and rule 11 keeps the ASV's supplied word from being marked added. The competing reading — article unrepresented, *their* folded onto ἀκοήν — is refused because rule 20 makes displacement the work of another expressed word.

s003 μέν is unrepresented under rule 70 (the ASV writes no *indeed*; the answering δέ keeps its own *and*), and s011 τούς under rule 23 (*fables* has no determiner, and rule 21 forbids leaving a bare *unto* on the article). A reference comparison will report the μέν as a disagreement; that report is not a correction.
ἀπό keeps *from* and the article beside it keeps *the* (rule 21), the case preposition not riding where an expressed preposition stands.
